'''Vorena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who lived during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]] to rebuild the world's colony. While there, he married Vorena and together they had one child, Jolee. The highest [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the planet was also named [[Mount Vorena]], in honor of Vorena.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Vorena was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] and her death drove Se'ol close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], so he climbed to the top of Mount Vorena, to meditate.<ref name="TUR" />
